overview_description.description: Based in San Francisco, SericaPay is a blockchain-based payments network that facilitates processing and payment networking for merchants that demand near-immediate, low-cost financial systems. It provides merchants with the ability to access a network of verified customers and grow their conversions, registrations, memberships, and average order sizes. It allows customers to use the details captured in their SericaPay accounts to purchase from any of the member vendors in the network. SericaPay was launched in 2015.
